title: dendrobium roylei
intro: Dendrobium roylei, commonly known as the Himalayan orchid, is a type of epiphytic orchid native to the Himalayan and Eastern Asian regions. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is believed to have a range of health benefits, including reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dendrobium roylei include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Dendrobium roylei include polysaccharides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
